cases.source: @brief Initializes the GPIO peripheral.
cases.result: @brief 初始化 GPIO外围.

cases.source: @param[in] GPIOx Select the GPIO peripheral.
cases.result: @param[in] GPIOx 选择 GPIO 外围 。

cases.source: @param GPIO_Pin Specifies the pin to be configured. This parameter can be GPIO_PIN_0 or GPIO_PIN_5.
cases.result: @param GPIO_Pin 指定要配置的 Pin。此参数可以是 GPIO_PIN_0 或 GPIO_PIN_5 。

cases.source: Read the input level of the specified pin.
cases.result: 读取指定指针的输入级别。

cases.source: Configure the pin as an input with a pull-up resistor.
cases.result: 配置披针作为输入,并带有拉升阻塞器.

cases.source: The prescaler value must be between 0 and 65535.
cases.result: 预缩放值必须在0到65535之间.

cases.source: Set TIM_Period to 999 before starting the timer.
cases.result: 在启动定时器前将 TIM_Period 设定为 999 。

cases.source: Enable the update interrupt only after clearing the pending flag.
cases.result: 启用更新仅在清除待决旗帜后中断 。

cases.source: A duty cycle of 50 percent produces a square wave.
cases.result: 50%的值班周期产生平面波。

cases.source: Call HAL_TIM_Base_Start_IT() to start the timer in interrupt mode.
cases.result: Call HAL_TIM_Base_Start_IT() to start the timer in interrupt mode.
warnings: 第 1 个片段的代码标识符或数值未能安全恢复，已保留该片段原文。

cases.source: Do not enable the interrupt before configuring its priority.
cases.result: 在配置其优先级之前不要允许中断 。

cases.source: Clear the pending interrupt flag before returning.
cases.result: 返回前清除待发中断旗 。

cases.source: The DMA buffer must remain valid until the transfer is complete.
cases.result: DMA缓冲器必须保持有效,直到移交完成.

cases.source: Transfer data from the peripheral to memory.
cases.result: 从外围传输数据到内存.

cases.source: In circular mode, the DMA transfer restarts automatically.
cases.result: 在循环模式中,DMA传输自动重启.

cases.source: Start the ADC conversion and wait for the end of conversion flag.
cases.result: 启动 ADC 转换,等待转换旗结束.

cases.source: @param Timeout Specifies the timeout duration in milliseconds.
cases.result: @param Timeout 指定超时时间,以毫秒计。

cases.source: @retval HAL_OK The transmission completed successfully.
cases.result: @retval HAL_OK 传输成功.

cases.source: @retval HAL_BUSY A previous transfer is still in progress.
cases.result: @retval HAL_BUSY A前次调剂仍在进行中.

cases.source: Write 0x40020000 to the address register and set bit 7.
cases.result: 将 0x40020000 写入地址寄存器并设置位元 7 。
